title: Man stabbed in chest at Parkside Commons in Syracuse
summary: A man was stabbed in the chest at Parkside Commons apartment complex (1813 East Fayette Street) on Friday evening around 6 p.m. Syracuse Police responded to the incident. This crime incident may inform public safety data collection and neighborhood safety assessments for the East Fayette Street area.
